daily_thesis: 7월 27일 배치의 결론은 robotics와 vision-language 연구가 더 큰 model score보다 action, scene, risk, and localization evidence를 시스템 계약으로 분리하는 방향으로 움직였다는 점입니다. Robot-Factored World Models와 GRACE는 action output을 바로 믿지 않고 rendered robot state와 gradient-free constraint guidance를 중간 표면으로 둡니다. SceneActBench와 SM4RT는 3D 능력을 텍스트 답변이 아니라 scene operation, motion basis, hidden geometry check로 묶습니다. JustDepth, CARA, Physical Agency, Mag4D-SLAM은 real-time depth, concept risk, tool-call verification, sensing substrate가 deployment failure를 설명하는 핵심 evidence임을 보여줍니다. APRL 관점에서는 policy 크기보다 action-to-state trace, scene-action benchmark, and sensing/risk evidence log를 먼저 소유하는 것이 더 방어적인 연구 자산입니다.

paper_autopsies.title: Robot-Factored World Models via Robot Rendering
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Action-conditioned video world models often treat the action signal as if it directly explains the next observation. That collapses controller limits, robot embodiment, and contact response into one opaque conditioning token.
paper_autopsies.friction: Robotics has two gaps at once: a raw action becomes a nominal robot trajectory through a controller, then the nominal trajectory changes the scene only through imperfect physical interaction.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A useful world model should expose the deployment-available robot state that mediates action, not require hidden privileged dynamics.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: The paper conditions video prediction on rendered nominal robot geometry, separating static scene context from robot motion evidence.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: A visual world-model interface carries static context and a rendered robot trajectory; the diffusion model predicts the resulting scene response.

decisive_evidence.claim: Static context, rendered nominal robot geometry, and scene response are separated in the visual world-model interface.
The paper explicitly distinguishes the action-to-nominal-trajectory gap from the nominal-trajectory-to-realized-state gap.
Robot-factored visual world-model interface is presented as the method core, not as a post-hoc visualization.
The paper frames actions as influencing observations through two distinct processes, matching the release thesis.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If rendered nominal geometry does not predict contact-rich state change better than raw action tokens under the same data budget, the robot-factored interface is mostly a visualization convenience.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Rendered robot geometry may encode controller bias without solving scene physics. It can also fail when the relevant state is tactile, deformable, or hidden behind occlusion rather than visible geometry.

paper_autopsies.title: SM4RT: Learning Structured Motion Geometry for 4D Reconstruction

paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: Motion should be represented as structured geometry with reusable bases and assignments before it can become a robot-usable state variable.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: SM4RT moves from geometry with motion to geometry of motion: motion bases describe component dynamics, and time-shared assignments bind points to those bases.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: The method predicts structured motion bases and dense rigid transform maps, producing world-coordinate tracks for dynamic 4D scenes.

paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Rigid transform maps can hide non-rigid contact and topology change. A high-quality 4D reconstruction still needs task-level validation before being called robot-usable.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Treat dynamic geometry as a set of reusable motion hypotheses that a planner can query, not as a single dense reconstruction artifact.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The representation is strongest for visually trackable structured motion; deformable manipulation and tool contact need additional physical state evidence.

paper_autopsies.title: GRACE: Gradient-Free Robot Action Generation via Combined Diffusion-MPPI Posterior Mean Estimation
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Diffusion policies can model multimodal demonstrations, but deployment-time safety or task constraints are often added through differentiable guidance costs.
paper_autopsies.friction: Many real robot constraints are non-differentiable, simulator-backed, or black-box, so differentiable guidance excludes exactly the checks needed at deployment.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A policy prior should stay multimodal while a separate optimizer enforces costs that were not differentiable or available during training.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: GRACE treats diffusion and MPPI as score-ascent components and estimates a cost-conditioned posterior mean without differentiating the cost or dynamics.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: At each denoising step, MPPI rollouts around the diffusion reverse mean are reweighted by deployment-time costs and projected back into the diffusion reverse kernel.

decisive_evidence.claim: The diffusion prior chooses the mode while gradient-free guidance keeps the trajectory safe around unseen obstacles.
The inference pipeline samples MPPI rollouts, reweights by constraint costs, and uses a projected reverse kernel.
The paper specifies a gradient-free inference procedure rather than only a conceptual wrapper.
Gradient guidance is presented as a differentiable special case, clarifying the broader design.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If MPPI rollouts require too much sampling for real-time manipulation or collapse diffusion diversity, the wrapper becomes a slow planner rather than a policy interface.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Gradient-free guidance can satisfy the specified cost while missing unmodeled safety constraints. The cost library becomes the real safety boundary.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Keep the learned policy prior and the deployment constraint evaluator separate, then measure the cost of that separation in latency and mode collapse.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The idea transfers to constraints that can be evaluated cheaply at inference; high-dimensional contact and delayed failures need surrogate costs or receding-horizon checks.

paper_autopsies.title: JustDepth: Real-Time Radar-Camera Depth Estimation with Single-Scan LiDAR Supervision
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Depth estimation papers often optimize error while deployment stacks need a latency/accuracy trade-off that survives sparse radar and limited LiDAR supervision.

paper_autopsies.title: Addressing the Orchestration Gap in Generalist Robots via Physical Agency
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Generalist robot systems often push perception, planning, success detection, recovery, and low-level control into a single opaque model stack.
